lines.text: London's highest rated restaurant didn't serve food and didn't even exist.
In 2017, writer Oobah Butler registered his backyard shed on TripAdvisor.
He called it The Shed at Dulwich with appointment-only reservations.
He photographed fake gourmet dishes made of bleach tablets and shaving foam.
Then he had friends post dozens of glowing five-star reviews.
Within six months, food critics were desperately begging for a table.
Wealthy executives offered thousands of dollars to jump the waiting list.
It officially hit number one out of eighteen thousand London restaurants.
For the grand opening, he served guests one-dollar microwave frozen dinners.
And customers gave it standing ovations... all because...
